skill.name: obsidian-vault
skill.description: Search, create, and organize Markdown notes in an Obsidian vault using title-cased filenames, wikilinks, backlinks, and index notes.
skill.summary: Manage a flat Obsidian vault through consistent note naming, search, wikilinks, backlinks, and topic indexes.
skill.author: mattpocock

content.value_statement: Finding and connecting notes in a flat Obsidian vault can be slow. This skill searches notes, creates consistent files, and maintains wikilinks and indexes.
actual_capabilities: Searches Markdown notes by filename or content within the configured vault.
Creates notes with title-cased filenames and focused learning content.
Adds Obsidian wikilinks to connect related notes.
Finds backlinks by searching for references to a selected note.
Locates and maintains index notes for related topics.
limitations: Uses a fixed vault path that may not match another computer or vault.
Assumes notes are stored mostly at the vault root.
Does not use the Obsidian application API or plugins.
Does not define backup, conflict resolution, or recovery procedures.

use_cases.title: Find Existing Research
use_cases.description: Search filenames and note contents before creating duplicate research notes.
use_cases.target_user: Researchers managing a growing Obsidian knowledge base

use_cases.title: Capture Connected Learning
use_cases.description: Create focused notes with consistent titles and links to related concepts.

use_cases.title: Maintain Topic Indexes
use_cases.description: Locate index notes and organize related topics through Obsidian wikilinks.
use_cases.target_user: Knowledge managers maintaining shared topic maps

prompt_templates.title: Find a Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my Obsidian vault for notes about [topic]. Show the most relevant filenames and explain each match briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Connected Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a focused note titled [title] about [topic]. Use the vault naming rules and link it to relevant existing notes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create one note with related links

prompt_templates.title: Build a Topic Index
prompt_templates.prompt: Find notes related to [topic], identify the best index note, and add missing wikilinks without duplicating existing entries.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Note Connections
prompt_templates.prompt: Review notes about [topic]. Report missing backlinks, isolated notes, duplicate coverage, and index gaps before proposing targeted updates.

output_examples.output: Found RAG Index, Retrieval Pipelines, and Embedding Evaluation. RAG Index is the primary topic map; the other notes cover implementation and testing.

output_examples.input: Create a note about evaluating embedding models.
output_examples.output: Created Embedding Model Evaluation with focused evaluation criteria and links to RAG Index, Embeddings, and Retrieval Metrics.
Skills Index is referenced by three notes. Two related skill notes are isolated and should link back to the index.

best_practices: Search the vault before creating a note to avoid duplicate coverage.
Keep note filenames in title case and use wikilinks for relationships.
Review proposed file changes before modifying important notes or indexes.
anti_patterns: Do not create folders when the vault convention requires flat organization.
Do not add duplicate wikilinks to an existing index note.
Do not overwrite note content without checking its current purpose and links.

faq.question: Which note format does this skill support?
faq.answer: It works with Markdown notes and Obsidian wikilinks.

faq.question: Can it search note contents?
faq.answer: Yes. It can search filenames and Markdown contents within the configured vault.

faq.question: Can it find backlinks?
faq.answer: Yes. It searches the vault for wikilinks that reference a selected note title.

faq.question: Does it organize notes into folders?
faq.answer: No. The documented vault convention uses a mostly flat root with index notes and links.

faq.question: Can I use a different vault path?
faq.answer: The skill currently documents one fixed path. Update the skill configuration before using another vault.

faq.question: Does it back up notes before editing?
faq.answer: No backup workflow is defined. Use version control or another backup system before significant changes.
